_comment: High/critical npm advisories accepted on purpose. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; after `until` the CI audit fails again so the decision is re-made, not forgotten.

advisories.reason: Pulled in only by Prisma's CLI config loader (prisma -> @prisma/config). npm's only fix is a downgrade to Prisma 6. Take the Prisma 7 patch when Dependabot opens it.
Pulled in only by Prisma's CLI tooling; the app talks to Postgres and never loads mysql2. Same upstream fix as above.
